analysis.overall: You spent a solid 93% of your day in range with a very stable overnight, despite a evening low and a sharp rise after late morning carbs.

events.title: Lunch spike handled smoothly
events.description: After a 50g carb lunch, glucose peaked gently around 171 mg/dL before small automated and manual corrections brought you back under 140 mg/dL.

events.title: Post-dinner low
events.description: Insulin for your 30g carb dinner acted quickly, dropping your glucose to a low of 56 mg/dL before carb treatment and temp targets brought you back into range.

events.title: Late-night rise
events.description: Blood sugar climbed up to 207 mg/dL around midnight, requiring a series of small correction boluses to turn the trend around.

events.title: Steady overnight baseline
events.description: Once the midnight corrections landed, glucose stayed virtually flat between 100 and 125 mg/dL all night long.

events.title: Late morning spike
events.description: A 50g carb meal at 10:43 AM absorbed quickly, driving glucose up to 223 mg/dL and prompting a follow-up correction.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on dinner meal timing or upfront insulin, as dinner bolusing led to a rapid dip this evening.
